description: This source file defines the UnknownFieldMarker class used within the Orleans serialization framework to represent an unknown field in a data stream, including its position and field header information.

classes.name: UnknownFieldMarker
classes.description: A marker object used to denote an unknown field and its position in a data stream, encapsulating its field header and position.

methods.name: UnknownFieldMarker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an instance with a specified field header and position.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the marker, including position and field header.
